title: Aphrodisiac
summary: APHRODIS'IAC, APHRODISI'ACAL, adjective [Gr. venereal, Venus, from froth.] Exciting venereal desire; increasing the appetite for sexual connection. APHRODIS'IAC, noun A provocative to venery.
